title: Project Blue Book and the Pentagon report contradict each other

tellings.quote: blue book yes and the pentagon report do not seem to be particularly compatible in other words it appears that either we were lying then that there's nothing to see yeah and we're telling the truth now

plain: Eric Weinstein, a researcher debating on Jesse Michels's podcast, compares two government records: Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, and a 2021 Pentagon report on unidentified objects in the sky. He says the two do not seem to fit together. In his view, either the government was lying back then when it said there was nothing to see, or it is telling the truth now, and it cannot be both.
